findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp-public" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_paid_order_status, list_paid_orders · Private data: create_checkout, create_paid_order, get_checkout_status, get_paid_order_status, get_service, list_paid_orders, recommend_service, search_catalog · Public sink: create_paid_order, get_paid_order_status, list_paid_orders.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_paid_order_status, list_paid_orders · Private data: create_checkout, create_paid_order, get_checkout_status, get_paid_order_status, get_service, list_paid_orders, recommend_service, search_catalog · Public sink: create_paid_order, get_paid_order_status, list_paid_orders

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
